title: Long-Horizon Investment with Delayed Information in a Mean-Reverting Market
abstract: arXiv:2610.21447v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study long-term investment in an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck diffusion model with exponential utility. We solve the finite-horizon problem explicitly and show that information delay qualitatively alters long-horizon behavior. Under full information, the certainty equivalent generated by mean reversion grows quadratically with the investment horizon. With any fixed positive delay, it grows only linearly, at an asymptotic rate that we compute explicitly. We derive an explicit causal representation of the optimal delayed portfolio and show that projecting the full-information strategy onto delayed information can fail dramatically: the resulting exponential loss becomes infinite for sufficiently long horizons. Numerical examples illustrate the economic impact of information delay.

translated_title: 均值回归市场中具有延迟信息的长期投资
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在具有指数效用的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck扩散模型中的长期投资问题。我们显式地求解了有限期限问题，并证明信息延迟会定性地改变长期投资行为。在完全信息下，由均值回归产生的确定性等价随投资期限呈二次增长；而在任何固定正延迟下，它仅呈线性增长，其渐近速率我们已显式计算得出。我们推导出了最优延迟投资组合的显式因果表示，并证明将完全信息策略投影到延迟信息上可能会剧烈失效：对于足够长的投资期限，由此产生的指数损失将变为无穷大。数值例子说明了信息延迟的经济影响。
tldr: 本文在Ornstein-Uhlenbeck模型中显式求解了带信息延迟的长期投资问题，发现信息延迟会将确定性等价的增长从二次降为线性，且将完全信息策略直接投影到延迟信息上会导致无穷大的指数损失。
en_tdlr: This paper explicitly solves the long-horizon investment problem with information delay in an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck model, showing that delay reduces the certainty equivalent growth from quadratic to linear, and that projecting the full-information strategy onto delayed information can incur infinite exponential losses.
